body:
### Summary

With `preview-features = ["centralized-project-envs"]`, `uv` properly installs virtualenvs outside of the project directory, but it still pollutes the project directory with a `.venv` symlink.

If the project directory is read-only `uv venv` outright fails, since the symlink is created unconditionally.

I'd like to disable creation of this symlink.
title: centralized-project-envs: disable creation of .venv symlink
